description: Offline check of the format, and of the check digit where the number type has a public one, for up to 50 tax or company numbers outside the EU (e.g. GB VAT, NO, AU ABN, NZ IRD, SG UEN, JP corporate number, CA BN, US EIN, IN GSTIN, BR CNPJ, MX RFC, TR, ZA, KR, AR, CL, CN, CO, IL, RU, UA) as well as EU VAT IDs and Swiss UIDs. Each answer states its depth: 'only the format was checked', 'nothing was checked' (no number was given) or 'not supported'. It never says that a number is registered.

tax_ids.description: 1 to 50 numbers, each with its country.

number.description: The number, with or without separators.

name: validate_tax_id_format
title: Validate tax ID format worldwide
